chunks: Muhammad ibn Qays narrated from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:

If a man pledges a piece of land containing fruit, then its produce is counted as part of the reckoning of his property. He is also entitled to account for what he worked on and spent on it. So when he has fully recovered his property, he must return the land to its owner.

key_terms.أَرْضًا: a piece of land given in pledge
key_terms.أَنْفَقَ: spent or expended on the land
key_terms.اسْتَوْفَى: fully received or recovered in due
key_terms.ثَمَرَةٌ: fruit or produce growing on the land

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on fruit and expenses in land given as collateral (rahn)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on pledged land that bears fruit. The produce is to be included in the financial reckoning, and the pledge-holder may also account for his labor and expenditures on the land. Once the owed amount has been fully satisfied, the land must be returned to its owner.
